member.name: T:ConsoleButtons.ConsoleMetrics
member.summary: Translates between screen pixels and console character cells. Nothing here is hardcoded: the cell size is measured from the window itself, so it stays correct across font changes, DPI scaling and window resizes.

member.name: P:ConsoleButtons.ConsoleMetrics.Handle
member.summary: Handle of the console window. More reliable than Process.MainWindowHandle, which returns Zero in a few launch scenarios.

member.name: M:ConsoleButtons.ConsoleMetrics.CellSize
member.summary: Size of one character cell in screen pixels. Measured by dividing the window's client area (which already excludes the title bar and the borders) by how many cells the console says it is showing.

member.name: M:ConsoleButtons.ConsoleMetrics.MouseClientPixels
member.summary: Mouse position in pixels relative to the top-left of the text area.

member.name: M:ConsoleButtons.ConsoleMetrics.MouseCellPrecise
member.summary: Mouse position in console cell coordinates, keeping the fraction inside the cell. Useful for smooth dragging.

member.name: M:ConsoleButtons.ConsoleMetrics.MouseCell
member.summary: Mouse position snapped to the cell it is over, in the same coordinate space as Console.SetCursorPosition.

member.name: T:ConsoleButtons.TextMetrics
member.summary: Measures strings in console cells, so a component's collider can be derived from what it actually paints instead of being tuned by hand.

member.name: M:ConsoleButtons.TextMetrics.Measure(System.String)
member.summary: Width of the longest line, and the number of lines.

member.name: M:ConsoleButtons.TextMetrics.DisplayWidth(System.String)
member.summary: How many cells the console actually paints for this string. Not the same as string.Length: an emoji is two UTF-16 units but paints two cells, while a CJK glyph is one unit and also paints two.

member.name: F:ConsoleButtons.Mouse.ConsoleMousePoint
member.summary: Cursor in console cells — the coordinate space colliders live in.

member.name: F:ConsoleButtons.Mouse.LocalMousePoint
member.summary: Cursor in pixels, relative to the top-left of the text area.

member.name: M:ConsoleButtons.MouseExt.GetCursorPositionRaw
member.summary: Screen-space cursor position, in the form ScreenToClient expects.

member.name: F:ConsoleButtons.UIComponent.AABB
member.summary: Collider, in console character cells. Measured, never hand-tuned.

member.name: M:ConsoleButtons.UIComponent.Render
member.summary: Exactly what this component paints. Single source of truth: the collider is measured from this, so the two can never drift apart.

member.name: M:ConsoleButtons.UIComponent.HitArea
member.summary: The clickable part of the render. Defaults to all of it.

member.name: M:ConsoleButtons.UIComponent.Recalculate
member.summary: Re-measures the collider from what the component currently paints.

member.name: M:ConsoleButtons.UIComponent.WriteAt(System.Int32,System.Int32,System.String)
member.summary: Console.Write, never WriteLine: a newline printed on the bottom row scrolls the whole buffer up and leaves every other component one row out of place.
